job.name: ig20_cover
job.person_note: The SAME woman as in the attached photo: same face shape, copper bob, mustard blazer; do not change her face.
job.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER, photorealistic. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED. No logos, no watermarks, no UI elements.
job.style_qa: обложка: та же женщина, что на референсе, держит длинный бумажный чек; надпись «ЭТО ВИДЕО СТОИЛО МНЕ 0 ₽» без ошибок; на чеке допускается только «ИТОГО 0 ₽»; других слов и логотипов нет
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16, dark graphite background (#111311) with a soft orange (#F3531B) rim light. In the lower 55% of the frame: the woman from the reference, waist up, with a sly knowing look, holds up a long curling white paper till receipt towards the camera; at the bottom of the receipt a bold line «ИТОГО 0 ₽», other receipt lines are just dots and dashes. At the TOP of the frame, centred, huge bold condensed sans-serif title in two lines: white «ЭТО ВИДЕО СТОИЛО МНЕ» and below it in bright orange «0 ₽». The title block fully inside the central 3:4 safe area (between 14% and 86% of the height).
